notes.title: Patroller Missions and Other Skiers Update
notes.notes: Added other skiers to the mountains. Ski patrol missions can be undertaken for gift cards and money by talking to other skiers. Other skiers will crash into you while skiing, so be careful! Snow graphics adjusted. UI adjusted. Some animations and graphics improved.

notes.title: Small graphics update
notes.notes:
This patch adds a feature that allows you to create a depression in the snow as you ski through it. Lighting of the snow has also been slightly adjusted.  Snow texture has also been adjusted.

The number of objects spawning in the world has been slightly increased to help prevent situations where no objects can be found. This does not fully solve the problem but it will help mitigate the issue for the time being.
